constraints: Not available on list box column objects.
If objectName uses the wildcard character ('@') to match multiple objects, only the value of the first matched object's data source is returned.
If the data source is an array, returns the array index (an integer); if it is an expression, returns the value evaluated since the last execution cycle.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the current value of the data source of the form object(s) named by objectName.
